rounds: Most “revolutionary” new gadgets turn out to be a waste of money.
Self-driving taxis will be normal in Berlin within ten years.
Printed books will still be around long after e-readers have disappeared.
Smartphones have made our lives better, not worse.
Old companies that can't keep up deserve to disappear.
Big companies are better at improving ideas than inventing them.
AI will put more companies out of business than the internet did.
A company's best ideas usually come from its youngest employees.
